extracted.name: Elevator Lady Spice Cookies
instruction_lines: Cream together the butter and sugar
Add the egg and molasses and beat together well
In a separate bowl sift and mix flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, cloves, and ginger.
Gradually add wets to dry mixture.
Put them 2 inches apart on a greased baking sheet
Bake at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 9-10 minutes, until crinkly on top
